content.text: Rim is 0.7. Move near a wall and wait for enemies.
Fighting fodder with kicks; next I'll kick the one to the east.
Kick east (30hp, winding up) and west.
Low on health (12), still fighting the crowd; punching the nearest one.

I died in box 1 after about 16 game seconds. I escaped no boxes and got 5 kills for a score of 600.

The fodder swarmed me from several sides. Each hit cost 8 HP, and my punches and kicks mostly didn't kill them before they hit back. The debris never piled up against a wall, so I never got near the rim.
